(2) With a quick, synchronized movement, the women pull the shoes they are holding away from each other toward the floor. Through a jump cut edit, a third pair of beige and white sneakers suddenly appears resting on the floor between them. (3) The duo swiftly brings the original two shoe soles back to the center of the frame, overlapping them to hide the newly appeared pair on the floor. They settle back into their initial pose, looking directly into the camera lens with neutral but slightly playful facial expressions. The indoor setting is brightly lit with warm, even lighting.
